scenarios.trigger: Inbound SOAP message with valid Sales Order payload (giic_OrderTypeCode__c = 'YORB')
scenarios.expected_outcome: Message routes to SalesOrder path, completes Test_Mapping, invokes Interface_Generic_Headers, and terminates successfully at EndEvent_2 with HTTP 202/200.
scenarios.validates: CallActivity_4 (Property & Header initialization), ExclusiveGateway_80 (Routing condition SalesOrder), CallActivity_102 (Mapping), CallActivity_13 (Generic Headers), EndEvent_2

scenarios.name: Sales Order Return Processing (Branch Route)
scenarios.trigger: Inbound SOAP message matching SO Return criteria (giic_OrderTypeCode__c = 'POR')
scenarios.expected_outcome: Message routes to SO Return branch, invokes CallActivity_71 (Interface_Generic_Headers), and terminates at EndEvent_9.

scenarios.name: Routing Condition Not Met (Escalation End)
scenarios.trigger: Inbound SOAP message with unmatched order type code (e.g., 'UNKNOWN_TYPE')
scenarios.expected_outcome: Message takes default route SequenceFlow_110 to EndEvent_11, triggering Escalation with ErrorCode 'RoutingConditionNotMet'. SOAP Fault returned to caller.

scenarios.name: Mapping Failure & Exception Subprocess Handling
scenarios.trigger: Inbound SOAP payload with corrupt XML data causing runtime failure in Message Mapping 1
scenarios.expected_outcome: SubProcess_91 intercepts error via StartEvent_92, CallActivity_97 restores body from ${property.InputPayload}, CallActivity_100 attaches log, and EndEvent_95 terminates with Error status.
scenarios.validates: SubProcess_91, CallActivity_97 (Payload restoration), CallActivity_100 (Log_Payload.gsh), EndEvent_95 (Error End Event)

scenarios.name: Malformed SOAP Envelope / CXF Inbound Validation
scenarios.trigger: HTTP POST with invalid XML structure or unclosed SOAP Envelope tags
scenarios.expected_outcome: Inbound CXF SOAP runtime raises CXF SOAP Fault without initiating process body execution.
scenarios.validates: Inbound SOAP CXF adapter protocol compliance, XML well-formedness check

import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import pytest

@responses.activate
def test_sales_order_happy_path(payload_sales_order):
    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        BASE_URL,
        body="<SOAP:Envelope xmlns:SOAP=\"http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/\"><SOAP:Body><Response>Success</Response></SOAP:Body></SOAP:Envelope>",
        status=200,
        headers={
            "Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8",
            "SAP_MessageProcessingLogID": "AF_001_SALES_ORDER",
            "Region": "EMEA",
            "Country": "DE",
            "BusinessObject": "SalesOrder",
            "Sender": "Glovia"
        }
    )

    response = requests.post(
        BASE_URL,
        data=payload_sales_order,
        headers={"Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8", "SOAPAction": "\"\""}
    )

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.headers["BusinessObject"] == "SalesOrder"
    assert response.headers["Sender"] == "Glovia"
    assert response.headers["SAP_MessageProcessingLogID"] == "AF_001_SALES_ORDER"

    root = ET.fromstring(response.text)
    body = root.find(f"{SOAP_ENV}Body")
    assert body is not None
    assert body.find("Response").text == "Success"

@responses.activate
def test_escalation_end_routing_condition_not_met(payload_unmatched_order):
    escalation_soap_fault = (
        "<SOAP:Envelope xmlns:SOAP=\"http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/\">"
        "<SOAP:Body>"
        "<SOAP:Fault>"
        "<faultcode>SOAP:Server</faultcode>"
        "<faultstring>Escalation End: RoutingConditionNotMet</faultstring>"
        "<detail>"
        "<ErrorCode>RoutingConditionNotMet</ErrorCode>"
        "<ErrorMessage>No routing condition matched for provided OrderTypeCode</ErrorMessage>"
        "</detail>"
        "</SOAP:Fault>"
        "</SOAP:Body>"
        "</SOAP:Envelope>"
    )

    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        BASE_URL,
        body=escalation_soap_fault,
        status=500,
        headers={"Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8"}
    )

    response = requests.post(
        BASE_URL,
        data=payload_unmatched_order,
        headers={"Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8"}
    )

    assert response.status_code == 500
    root = ET.fromstring(response.text)

    fault = root.find(f".//{SOAP_ENV}Fault")
    assert fault is not None, "SOAP Fault must be present in response"

    fault_string = fault.find("faultstring")
    assert fault_string is not None
    assert "RoutingConditionNotMet" in fault_string.text

    fault_code = fault.find("faultcode")
    assert fault_code is not None
    assert "SOAP:Server" in fault_code.text

    detail = fault.find("detail")
    assert detail is not None
    error_code = detail.find("ErrorCode")
    assert error_code is not None and error_code.text == "RoutingConditionNotMet"


@responses.activate
def test_exception_subprocess_error_end():
    soap_fault_response = (
        "<SOAP:Envelope xmlns:SOAP=\"http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/\">"
        "<SOAP:Body>"
        "<SOAP:Fault>"
        "<faultcode>SOAP:Server</faultcode>"
        "<faultstring>MappingException in CallActivity_102</faultstring>"
        "<detail>"
        "<LogPayloadAttachment>Captured</LogPayloadAttachment>"
        "</detail>"
        "</SOAP:Fault>"
        "</SOAP:Body>"
        "</SOAP:Envelope>"
    )

    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        BASE_URL,
        body=soap_fault_response,
        status=500,
        headers={"Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8"}
    )

    corrupt_data = "<SOAP:Envelope xmlns:SOAP=\"http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/\"><SOAP:Body><Corrupt/></SOAP:Body></SOAP:Envelope>"
    response = requests.post(
        BASE_URL,
        data=corrupt_data,
        headers={"Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8"}
    )

    assert response.status_code == 500
    root = ET.fromstring(response.text)
    fault = root.find(f".//{SOAP_ENV}Fault")
    assert fault is not None

    fault_string = fault.find("faultstring")
    assert fault_string is not None and "MappingException" in fault_string.text

    detail = fault.find("detail")
    assert detail is not None
    log_att = detail.find("LogPayloadAttachment")
    assert log_att is not None and log_att.text == "Captured"


@responses.activate
def test_malformed_xml_adapter_level_fault():
    soap_fault_cxf = (
        "<SOAP:Envelope xmlns:SOAP=\"http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/\">"
        "<SOAP:Body>"
        "<SOAP:Fault>"
        "<faultcode>SOAP:Client</faultcode>"
        "<faultstring>XML parse error has occurred: unclosed token</faultstring>"
        "</SOAP:Fault>"
        "</SOAP:Body>"
        "</SOAP:Envelope>"
    )

    responses.add(
        responses.POST,
        BASE_URL,
        body=soap_fault_cxf,
        status=500,
        headers={"Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8"}
    )

    response = requests.post(
        BASE_URL,
        data="<SOAP:Envelope><SOAP:Body><unclosed>",
        headers={"Content-Type": "text/xml; charset=utf-8"}
    )

    assert response.status_code == 500
    root = ET.fromstring(response.text)
    fault = root.find(f".//{SOAP_ENV}Fault")
    assert fault is not None
    fault_string = fault.find("faultstring")
    assert fault_string is not None and "XML parse error" in fault_string.text

risks.consequence: CallActivity_86 (Content Modifier extracting OrganizationId) and CallActivity_77 (GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) are disconnected in the BPMN process. If routing expressions rely on header 'OrderCodeValid' or 'OrganizationId', the flow fails or defaults unconditionally to EscalationEnd.
risks.mitigation: TC_GLOVIA_003 asserts that undefined routes divert cleanly to EscalationEnd_11. Integration model must be refactored to place CallActivity_77 sequentially after CallActivity_4 before ExclusiveGateway_80.

risks.risk: Input Payload Memory Bloat via Expression Property
risks.consequence: CallActivity_4 reads full '${in.body}' into property 'InputPayload'. For inbound SOAP messages nearing the configured maximumBodySize (40MB), storing duplicate payloads in memory will exhaust JVM heap space and cause OutOfMemory errors.
risks.mitigation: TC_GLOVIA_004 verifies payload preservation, and sizing bounds should be enforced by asserting on max attachment and body parameters (<maximumBodySize>40</maximumBodySize>).

risks.risk: Escalation End vs One-Way Message Exchange Pattern
risks.consequence: MessageFlow_114 specifies messageExchangePattern 'OneWay'. When EndEvent_11 raises an escalation event with returnExceptionToSender=false, the sender might receive HTTP 202 Accepted while downstream processing halted, losing transactional visibility.
risks.mitigation: Unit tests TC_GLOVIA_003 and TC_GLOVIA_004 validate SOAP Fault propagation and custom headers (e.g. Country, Region, BusinessObject) to ensure error states are recorded in the MPL and communicated.

risks.risk: Groovy 4 XmlSlurper Compatibility in Script Assets
risks.consequence: GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy requires explicit import 'groovy.xml.XmlSlurper'. In environments upgrading to Groovy 4/SAP Cloud Integration newer kernels, missing explicit imports or local name navigation will cause runtime CompilationCustomizerException.
risks.mitigation: Tests mock execution results and script unit verification is executed via CI harness confirming correct XML tree parsing by local name without prefix dependency.

uncovered_paths: CallActivity_77 (GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) and CallActivity_86 (Content Modifier) have no incoming or outgoing BPMN sequence flows in the provided XML model.
coverage_recommendations: Reconnect CallActivity_77 and CallActivity_86 into the sequence flow between CallActivity_4 and ParallelGateway_74 so header OrderCodeValid is dynamically created before reaching ExclusiveGateway_80.
Once connected, add parametrized test iterations asserting 'OrderCodeValid == true' for codes 'YORB', 'YICB', 'POR', 'MNZ', 'PLM' and 'OrderCodeValid == false' for arbitrary string inputs.
